summary_points.text: Delphi Desk is a decision-review cockpit: a Delphi-style panel drafts proposals with evidence receipts, and every consequential action (approve / request changes / escalate / annotate) is one defineAction() shared by the human UI and the agent.
The data model mirrors the repo's Delphi envelope and the CMDB conflict matrix (infrastructure registry design, 36 KB on master).

The starting machinery is operational and demonstrated: the offline Oracle MVP is merged (PR #1620) with a CI receipt, and the D0 package (agent + fetch_evidence tool) is its working seam, completed 2026-10-27.
The panel runs deterministically and locally, so the demo never depends on an API key.
Publishing a public Clips demo needs no Builder account.

title: Delphi Desk — decision-review cockpit for the Builder.io Agent-Native Hackathon
